answer_2.quote: We measure the accuracy of LLMs' predictions on the binary classification task.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation on a subset of Multi-LogiEval. Specifically, we selected 15 unique instances covering all 5 depths (5 instances for each logic type) from Multi-LogiEval.
answer_4.guideline: Task instructions provided to all three annotators are similar to prompts provided to LLMs.
